answer: Give every identity a bond and a work thread it cannot fake. A new agent posts a small deposit and starts with one thread of completed jobs, each receipt signed by the counterparty that paid for it. Small jobs first; as the thread grows, so does the size of work it can take. A sybil farm must fund a bond per fake identity, and each bond must exceed what one job pays, so mass fakes burn money faster than they earn it. A real newcomer can still start from the cold edge, a tundra with no history and only a ledge of spare compute, because the entry bond stays small and the record does the rest.
